summary: Devsecops agent failed to run a complete audit this cycle — last-report.md persisted at 0 bytes. Recording a single placeholder finding (DSO-001) capturing the empty-audit state so the safe_prod_write gate evaluator sees the explicit UNVERIFIABLE signal rather than silently treating absence as PASS. Re-run after harness Write allowlist is widened (program-director PD-003).

findings.title: Empty devsecops audit at HEAD 28f7942 — crash_loop / secrets_changed / migration_without_rollback gates UNVERIFIABLE
findings.recommended_fix: Re-run devsecops-agent after agents/settings.json Write allowlist is widened (PD-003). Audit must populate at minimum: crash_loop status, secrets_changed status, migration_without_rollback status, and an audit_complete=true marker. Until that happens, safe_prod_write cannot be evaluated and program-director PD-001 will continue to BLOCK.
tests_required: jq -r '.findings | length' agents/devsecops-agent/last-findings.json (must be > 1, i.e. real findings beyond this placeholder)
